signature.reason: Cryptographic envelope signing requires a trust anchor outside this repository (AGENTS.md section 30.8 item 2: bOPEN's verifier runs inside the tree it judges). Until then the envelope's integrity rests on git history and the human merge that ratified it, and the classifier treats an unsigned envelope as valid ONLY for tiers at or below the ratified tier.

advance_conditions: 30 consecutive auto-merged PRs with zero rollback
no CONSTITUTIONAL_REQUIRED verdict misclassified as lower

AT3.authority: Governance implementation (AD1) without fresh operator approval
advance_conditions: 60 days of shadow-mode evidence comparing base and head gate decisions

AT4.authority: Scope and ceiling adjustment inside the GL-0 absolute maxima (AD2)
advance_conditions: full ballot quorum with no veto
rollback verified by execution, not by description

ballot_layer.reason: bOPEN has two available verifying agents (Claude, Codex — AGENTS.md section 30.6); EBIV section 6.5 operates a CONFIRMED_UNDER_TWO_AGENT_PROFILE precisely because the population is too small for a role-separated quorum. One session emitting role-labelled ballots is self-approval in several hats; role banners are self-asserted text and must never gate a decision. Quorum is therefore not enforced anywhere in code, and every verdict that would depend on it escalates to the operator instead.
ballot_layer.quorum_when_active: 4 of 5, with governance and security holding veto; 5 of 5 for AD2-AD3

gate_activation.note: A change to a gate script merges INACTIVE and takes effect in the next governance epoch, so no PR is judged by the gate it introduces. Enforced today by the dual-policy rule (base and head logic must agree); full epoch machinery is deferred.
